name: Respiratory Bronchiolitis-Interstitial Lung Disease
aliases: Respiratory Bronchiolitis with Interstitial Lung Disease

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Respiratory Bronchiolitis-Interstitial Lung Disease Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Current or former history of cigarette smoking
Presence of pigmented macrophages in respiratory bronchioles on lung biopsy
High-resolution CT showing centrilobular nodules and patchy ground-glass opacities
Mild restrictive ventilatory defect and reduced diffusion capacity on pulmonary function tests
Exclusion of other interstitial lung diseases such as desquamative interstitial pneumonia or hypersensitivity pneumonitis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of smoking history, characteristic histopathology, compatible imaging findings, and exclusion of other interstitial lung diseases
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Lung biopsy is often required to confirm diagnosis; clinical correlation with smoking history is essential.

pathognomonic.notes: Essential risk factor and clinical feature

common.symptomName: Mild hypoxemia at rest or exertion
Reduced diffusion capacity for carbon monoxide (DLCO)

laboratory: Mild hypoxemia on arterial blood gas analysis
Normal or mildly elevated inflammatory markers
imaging: High-resolution CT showing centrilobular nodules, patchy ground-glass opacities, and mild interstitial thickening
other: Lung biopsy demonstrating pigmented macrophages in respiratory bronchioles with mild interstitial inflammation

distinguishingFeatures: More diffuse alveolar involvement with abundant macrophages
More extensive ground-glass opacities on imaging
Progressive fibrosis with poor response to smoking cessation

references: American Thoracic Society/European Respiratory Society International Multidisciplinary Consensus Classification of the Idiopathic Interstitial Pneumonias, Am J Respir Crit Care Med. 2002
Respiratory bronchiolitis-associated interstitial lung disease: clinical features and outcome, Chest. 2000
High-resolution CT findings in respiratory bronchiolitis-associated interstitial lung disease, Radiology. 1997
